name: searchBookByBarCode
intent: Find books by a copy barcode.
pre: The supplied barcode is a string.
post: Return exactly the registered books having at least one copy whose barcode equals barcode.
difficulty_basis: Book-to-copy traversal and nested existence filter.
scenarios: Matching copy leads to its book being returned; nonmatching/multiple/empty cases untested.
Numeric barcode violates explicit string-type guard.
effects_audit: No mutation, case normalization, fuzzy matching, sorting, authentication or additional nonempty guard added. Returned collection can be empty; tests do not exhaust filter correctness.
